description: This file defines an interface 'ExecutionContextTenantAndAuthIdProvider' which provides a method to retrieve tenant and authorization ID information from an execution context, returning a Future that encapsulates the result or failure.

classes.name: ExecutionContextTenantAndAuthIdProvider
classes.description: A Java interface parameterized with a type T extending ExecutionContext, providing a method to fetch tenant and auth-id info asynchronously.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves tenant and auth-id information from the provided execution context, returning a Future object that completes with TenantObjectWithAuthId or fails with an error.
